title.narrative: Child Protection training for CAFOD staff and Partners

description.narrative:
Mujaddidun is CAFOD’s current National NGO partner for implementation of education projects in 8 schools in the region of Khartoum. In the past year this partnership was mostly focused around infrastructure development for improved enrollment, retention and quality of education. Plans for the next period will involve lots of work with PTA, Friends of the school and Teachers for better quality improvement. With this in mind, Mujaddidun approached CAFOD asking for some help in developing their child protection expertise. CAFOD decided to expand this for all implementing partners both Mujaddidun in Khartoum state and SIDO in North Kordofan state in addition to participants from the diocese. This training will help our partners to mainstream child protection in all programmes.
CAFOD conducted child protection assessment within target partners Mujaddidun and SIDO and consulted them on their needs and gaps to be filled by the training. Therefore, CAFOD Sudan is seeking the support of child protection adviser in the following:
1.Mapping of child protection stakeholders 2.Mapping CP issues 3.Identify knowledge/practice and gaps in CAFOD and among partners with regards to CP 4.Initial training and provision of basic tools on CP for CAFOD and agreed partners 5.Work With CAFOD and partners on a mainstreaming road-map 6.Work Out role of partners, the schools and other stakeholders in CP
